expectations.evidence: The draft limits the claim to Halcyon's own case several times. It calls the result 'one data point from one service. Read it that way.' and says 'We did not move it because of anything wrong with Ruby in general.' A full 'When we wouldn't do this' section lists conditions tied to Halcyon's situation: the service isn't a bottleneck, the team has no Go experience, latency is I/O-bound, or the logic changes constantly.
